result.summary: The page mostly looks well structured; one minor visual inconsistency was found in the heart/favorite icon styling between cards.

issues.description: The favorite heart icon background is white/opaque on the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card but transparent/dark on the pizza card below it, creating inconsistent styling for the same UI element across cards.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the heart icon button background (e.g., consistent semi-transparent dark circle) across all restaurant cards for visual consistency.
